convention_rule: Among a row of similar objects counted left to right, the one lit green marks the target: position N means PN.
basis: r09: 1st boat green, P1. r10: 4th bench/table green, P4. r11: 3rd post and the centre path green, P3. r12: A and B both light the 3rd of 4 lamps green, so P3. P3 also differs from the client-correct P2 (lowest energy).
